sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 460. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge gains by 3 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Cost recovery speed reduced by 10 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Changes Cost held to 30. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies Fortify 25% for 120 seconds (when physical or magic damage exceeds a percentage of max HP equal to this effect's value, the total damage is instead converted into fixed damage equal to the same percentage of max HP. This effect reduces by 10 seconds each time it is triggered).
-Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 120 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Infinite Element (increases all stats by 120%, restores 5% of damage dealt as HP, and increases HP recovery effects by 50%) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Increases Ability cooldown times by 50% for 90 seconds.
Water and Star Defense from Unison Damage +600
